summary: MaintITProvisionRole is a web page and backend implementation for managing IT Provisioning Roles in an agency context. It provides listing, filtering, adding, editing, deleting, and reactivating IT Provisioning Role records via a grid and details view, with access controls dependent on user session and agency roles.
purpose: To allow system and local administrators to maintain (create, update, delete, and reactivate) IT Provisioning Role records for their agency, with view restrictions and controls based on user type and agency selection.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Name of the IT Provision Role (required, max 250 characters)

fields.name: ShortName
fields.description: Short display name for the IT Provision Role (required, max 20 characters)

fields.name: AgencyID
fields.description: Reference to Agency owning the role

workflows.name: ITProvisionRole Maintenance
steps: User loads page; dropdown of agencies is filled, focus is placed on ddAgency.
Grid displays ITProvisionRole records filtered by Agency, keyword and active/inactive status.
User can filter with ddAgency, txtKeyword, chkShowInactive.
System checks access based on UserSession: only SystemAdministrator or LocalAdministrator with correct agency can edit.
If editable, Add/Edit/Delete/Reactivate buttons appear in the grid; otherwise only view is allowed.
Add/Edit: Opens Detail View. Required fields validated (Name, ShortName). Save triggers Add or Update method.
Cancel: Closes detail popup without saving changes.
Refresh: Updates display after any operation (Add/Edit/Delete/Reactivate) or filter change.

business_rules: ITProvisionRole Name and ShortName must be specified when adding or editing.
Only SystemAdministrator or LocalAdministrator for the selected agency can edit or maintain records.
Roles cannot be added if agency dropdown is empty.
Roles are soft-deleted (marked inactive) rather than physically removed.
conditions: ScreenIsEditable enabled only if user session is SystemAdministrator or LocalAdministrator for current agency.
Add/Edit/Delete/Reactivate buttons only shown if screen is editable.
If page is in view-only mode or agency dropdown has no items, adding is not permitted.
system_behavior: Grid processes no data message and disables add button if screen is read-only.
Detail popup disables edit fields if not editable.
Refresh updates grid view after operations.
Error and warning panels display relevant messages and can be hidden.
dependencies: UserSession context drives access control and editing capability.
ITProvisionRoles data layer for fetching/updating/deleting/reactivating records.
exceptions: Attempt to add/edit/delete/reactivate without required permissions or agency selection is prevented.
If agency dropdown is empty, add is not permitted.
content_gaps: Underlying ITProvisionRole data model details (fields beyond Name, ShortName, AgencyID, Inactive) are not shown.
No details about error handling for data layer failures.
UI display logic (e.g., exact wording, resource translation details) is referenced but not fully specified.
